calibration.quantity: volume-equivalent diameter of the archived ADAM model
calibration.reference: DAMIT model 1811 calibrated size, Hanuš et al. (2017), A&A 601, A114
calibration.notes: DAMIT marks model 1811 as size-calibrated (D = 137 km, σ = 3 km), the volume-equivalent diameter of this ADAM solution. Hanuš et al. (2017) Table 4 lists 135 ± 3 km for the publication fit; the archived release is kept as archived. The fit used 9 light curves, 2 adaptive-optics images and 1 occultation (Table 3).
calibration.sourceLabel: DAMIT model 1811 calibrated size, Hanuš et al. (2017), A&A 601, A114
calibration.diameterSemantics: volume-equivalent diameter of the archived ADAM model
calibration.limitations: Uniform scale of the unchanged archived mesh by the adopted diameter and its quoted uncertainty. DAMIT marks model 1811 as size-calibrated (D = 137 km, σ = 3 km), the volume-equivalent diameter of this ADAM solution. Hanuš et al. (2017) Table 4 lists 135 ± 3 km for the publication fit; the archived release is kept as archived. The fit used 9 light curves, 2 adaptive-optics images and 1 occultation (Table 3).

modelLimitations: The nonconvex model, fitted to light curves, adaptive-optics images and stellar occultations, resolves large concavities where those data constrain them; craters and fine relief are unresolved.
